verdict.rationale: The runtime probe found that kimi.com publishes no llms.txt: the URL redirects to the app root, and the assistant app has no docs site. The only llms.txt found, at platform.kimi.ai, belongs to the Kimi API Open Platform, which the vendor's own product-plans doc treats as a separate product, so it does not count for this product. Nothing else in the pack documents agent-oriented docs for the Kimi assistant or Kimi Code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
